errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates a distribution of character types within the RoleplayPref dataset. The chart is divided into thirteen slices, representing different categories of characters, with a central, larger slice labeled “Custom Characters.”
errors.evidence: The chart is not a simple pie chart with thirteen slices. It is a nested pie chart (sunburst chart) with two levels: an inner ring showing 3 primary categories and an outer ring showing 13 subcategories. The description completely misrepresents this structure.

The description incorrectly lists the parent categories from the inner ring ("Virtual Characters", "Real Characters") as if they are slices in the outer ring, at the same level as their subcategories.
The slice for "Comic Characters" is light blue, not purple.
The slice for "Game Characters" is light blue, not teal.

errors.text_span: The slices appear ordered by decreasing size
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered by decreasing size. The five 'Virtual' subcategories are roughly equal, and the seven 'Real' subcategories are roughly equal, but there is no overall descending order across all slices.
The description completely fails to mention the hierarchical, two-level structure of the chart (an inner ring and an outer ring). This is the most important structural feature of the visualization.
